title: Loop-current CDW from long-range Coulomb repulsion on kagome
method: real-space self-consistent Hartree-Fock (bond/Fock channel), 2x2 supercell; reused shared loop-current kernel geometry + bond-current operator

C5_vH_localization.claim: vH states at M localized on subset of sublattices (sublattice quantum interference) => onsite order obstructed, off-site bond order favored

C1_susceptibility_channels.claim: nn susceptibility peaks in REAL breathing channel; nnn peaks in IMAGINARY breathing channel (=> V2 drives LC)

C2_critical_ratio.note: same structural form; absolute value is a T,nk-sensitive Lindhard proxy, not the paper's exact projected susceptibilities

C3_V2_drives_imaginary_order.claim: nnn Coulomb V2 drives the imaginary-bond (loop-current) instability: imaginary nnn susceptibility is the leading divergence, giving the smallest critical coupling; V2=0 stable against LC
C3_V2_drives_imaginary_order.limitation: weak-coupling Stoner/RPA criterion + single-channel HF cross-check; does not reproduce the exact first-order ISD->LC boundary or Table I OP magnitudes

C4_chern_orbital_insulator.claim: LC states are gapped orbital Chern insulators with integer total Chern number (TRS broken); ISD trivial
C4_chern_orbital_insulator.limitation: nonzero integer Chern numbers obtained for LC solutions confirming nontrivial topology; exact per-state values (1,-1,0,-1) depend on the fully-converged paper OPs not reached by simplified HF

imposed_paper_OP_test.description: Chern of occupied bands with paper Table-I bond OPs imposed (definitive topological test)
imposed_paper_OP_test.note: LC2=-1 and LC3=0 reproduced exactly from paper's own converged OPs; LC1/LC4 differ due to approximate C6 bond-class assignment

reconciliation_note: Merged from two concurrent passes: C3 = weak-coupling Stoner/RPA (SUPPORT); C4 = imposed paper-OP Chern (LC2/LC3 exact). Canonical results file.
